title: How To Make $2000+ Per Day With Uniswap MEV Bot Easy Tutorial 2023
description: :check mark button:Updated Tutorial: Working as of July 2024  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vYM-gVf-VEE  #Mevbot #uniswap #ethereum

asr.full_text: Oh it's about 1.37 ETHER. So basically it took me about a day to gain my deposit by more than a third! Hello everyone! In this youtube video tutorial I will be explaining to you an easy method to make passive income using Uniswap. Have you ever made a transaction in Uniswap where you forgot to decrease the slippage? If so, you may have received fewer tokens than you were expecting. This is because your transaction has been front run by a bot who takes advantage of the slippage. So basically in this video, we'll be talking about how to build a smart contract bot who does the same. My smart contract bot, which I'll call a front-running bot, will allow us to automatically trade a given token for the Ethereum blockchain on Uniswap and Woninch without having to go through the typical transaction methods. This is going to allow us to sniff the pending transactions that are not yet mined on the mem pool and then it's going to allow us to inject our transaction with a higher gas fee than the transaction which is entered. Now this will allow our transactions to be processed first and then will also send a sell order within the same block. So basically the victims transaction get sandwiched between hours and we make a profit from the slippage difference in the transaction let me explain more what front-running is with an example let's say that Alice wants to exchange a thousand dollars worth of Ethers for unitoken and let's supposed that the uni price is five dollars at the moment of the transaction. So if we do a simple calculation, Alice will receive 200 units of the unitokens, but as the prize of a token may increase, Uniswap requires users to set slippage, which means the percentage of an eventual price increase that you accept for this transaction to go through. Now, in this example, if Alice set slippage to 10% which means that she agrees to pay up to $5.5 per UNI token that's about about 181 tokens for the $1000. So when Alice submits the transaction using MetaMask the scenario will be like this. Our bot will spot Alice's transaction and by UNI token at the price of five dollars and increase the price so alice will buy higher alice will buy 181 units of uni token at a price of 5.5 so our bot will sell all the tokens bought on the first transaction and then keep the profit which is in the example it's about 91 dollars minus Gas fees. All that in the same block. So to start off you will need to have Metamask installed and connected to the ethereum mainnet. If you dont have Metamask installed, you can find a link in the description on how to install it. To deploy our contracts go to remix ethereum compiler Remix is a web application that allows us to develop deploy compile and launch smart contracts coded in the Solidity language now you'll find the link to the Remix web site in the description below. Now head over to the left sidebar and create a new file named Bot.Sold. Now if you look at the description I've included a link to this code you need to copy and paste that code. This is our Frontrunner Bot Contract that we re gonna deploy. A couple of things to look at after pasting the code are Line 55 and 56. If you check the addresses on Etherscan, you ll see that these are the addresses of wrapped EETHER tokens. Ok, so you can see its the official rapped ether address, its always a good idea to check that. Now back to Remix. Now that our bot file is ready let's compile it. On the side menu click Solidity Compiler. As you can see the contract is built for the 0.6.6 version of Solidity. Under compiler, select the version 0.6.6 so it'll match our contract now click on compile bot.sold and wait for the bot to compile so now we deploy this to our wallet head on over to deploy and run transactions on remix Under the environment, select injected Web three to connect remix to our Meta mask. Finally, make sure uniswap bot bot dot soul is selected under contract. Now the deployment utility is ready. Click the deploy button to publish our contract to the Ethereum blockchain. We need to confirm the creation of our contract by paying some gas fees. I always set gas fees to high so it'll speed up the transaction. There's not a lot of difference, but click confirm and wait for the transaction to be mined. Transaction confirmed. Now our contract is deployed. So as you can see here, there are four actions for a contract. The start button will start the bot, sniffing the mempool. Withdrawal will stop the bot, and transfer funds back to your wallet. Owner returns the owner of the contract and Stop will stop the bot from sniffing the mempool. So lets copy the contract address to make sure it was created, head back to Etherscan and paste it. Ok, it says it was a successfully created. So the next step is to fund our contract with some ethers to be able to snipe liquidity pools, I'm going to copy this address and head back over to my metamask and make sure you've copied the right address. You can fund the contract with whatever amount you want. But obviously the more you put in the larger, the transaction, you'll be able to front run. And the more profit you'll be able to accumulate over time. For instance, if you're only front running with 0.5 Ethers you won't be able to create as much slippage in the price as if you were inserting something like 10 Ethers. Sweet. There we go! Ok, so transaction confirmed and the contract is funded. We can check that by following our contract address on etherscan.io As you can see our contract has one ethereum on its balance, which is basically the amount we funded it with The last step is to click start Now this will enable the bot to start sniffing the mempool to find different liquidity pairs in order for you to front run the Transactions i'll see you guys in a couple hours well guys i want to share the profit the bot made for me so i have something around 1.17 ether which is around 17 you can see the transaction that our bot made the internal transactions tab as you can see the transaction that our BOT made the internal transactions tab as you can see here are the front run transactions that are bought made over the 10 hours there are a total of seven transactions now if we calculate the Some Profit minus Gas fees we get exactly 0.17 ETH so I'll see you in 10 hours alright guys, guys. Let's see how much more we made. Oh It's about 1.37 ether, so basically it took me about a day to gain my deposit by more than a third Something close to 40% which isn't that bad? So the BOT will continue to run until you press the withdrawal button, the bot will then exit the liquidity pool and will return back to your wallet. The ethers you entered initially plus the profit. So let's click it, this will charge us a little bit of gas. I'll set it to high again and we click confirm. There we go. the transaction is confirmed so let's go to our Metamask to check and see what I've got now. As you can see the Balance from BOT is now in my wallet. I've had some weeks where I made 5-6 Ethers Sometimes it's not always profitable and profits fluctuate weekly. But usually I make 2-Eth a week. Now profitable. Usually a Ethereum 2 plus. You can also contact me on Telegram to share your profits in the comment box. Hit the like button and subscribe for more!

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes an easy, high-return Uniswap bot method and instructs viewers to connect MetaMask, deploy a contract, pay gas fees, and fund it. It links larger funding to greater accumulated profit and reports about a 40% gain in roughly a day, while the records do not verify whether the code or returns are reproducible.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content links a trading bot to deployment, activation, funding with ether and claimed profit. The speaker instructs viewers to deploy the contract, fund it and start the bot, while stating that greater funding enables greater profit. The described bot explicitly uses front-running and sandwiching of pending Uniswap transactions to obtain profit from slippage, which is a presented market-manipulation mechanism. The records do not establish that the mechanism successfully worked.
